label: Town of Rupert
header:
# Town of Rupert municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 20; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Rupert, Certificate of Votes, Results of Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (196 votes cast; certified by the Town Clerk): Mark Lourie was elected Moderator with 184 votes
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk; Rupert elects its clerk to a three-year term
Town of Rupert, Certificate of Votes, Results of Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (196 votes cast; certified by the Town Clerk): Andrea Lenhardt was elected Town Clerk to a three-year term with 188 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Andrea Lenhardt as Rupert's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer; Rupert elects its treasurer to a three-year term

Town of Rupert, Certificate of Votes, Results of Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (196 votes cast; certified by the Town Clerk): Andrea Lenhardt was elected Town Treasurer to a three-year term with 187 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Andrea Lenhardt as Rupert's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists only four of Rupert's five selectboard members: Kyle Hunter (Chair), Philip Mazzucco, Charles Rockwell, and Thomas Wilson

Town of Rupert, Certificate of Votes, Results of Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (196 votes cast; certified by the Town Clerk): Kyle Hunter won a one-year seat (159 votes), Charles Rockwell the three-year seat (173), Colin Driscoll the two-year seat (94), and Philip E. Mazzucco a one-year seat (146)

Town of Rupert, 2025 Town Report, 'Rupert Town Officers' table: Colin Driscoll was appointed to the selectboard on October 14, 2025, after Deborah Baker resigned on August 26, 2025, and was then elected to the seat's two-year remainder in 2026; Thomas Wilson's term runs to 2027

offices.title: Lister
offices.org_name: Town of Rupert Board of Listers

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three
Town of Rupert, Certificate of Votes, Results of Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (196 votes cast; certified by the Town Clerk): Jed Rubin was re-elected a lister with 166 votes
Town of Rupert, 2025 Town Report, 'Rupert Town Officers' table: the listers are Jed Rubin (Chair), Carl Yackel (term to 2027), and Daniel Fuller (term to 2028)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated
Town of Rupert, Certificate of Votes, Results of Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (196 votes cast; certified by the Town Clerk): Kelly Joe Lewis was elected an auditor with 183 votes
Town of Rupert, 2025 Town Report, 'Rupert Town Officers' table: the auditors are Kelly Joe Lewis, Chris Porter (term to 2027), and Jeremy Russo (term to 2028)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a first constable
Town of Rupert, Certificate of Votes, Results of Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (196 votes cast; certified by the Town Clerk): Brett Lourie was elected First Constable to a two-year term with 177 votes
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns may elect a second constable

Town of Rupert, Certificate of Votes, Results of Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (196 votes cast; certified by the Town Clerk): Jay 'Skip' Wilson was elected Second Constable to a two-year term with 169 votes

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of Rupert Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes for a one-year term unless the town votes a longer term
Town of Rupert, Certificate of Votes, Results of Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (196 votes cast; certified by the Town Clerk): Mark Lourie was elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes with 182 votes

Town of Rupert, Certificate of Votes, Results of Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (196 votes cast; certified by the Town Clerk): Wendy McRoy (179 votes) and Lynn Vail (182 votes) were elected library trustees, taking the two seats expiring in 2026

Town of Rupert, 2025 Town Report, 'Rupert Town Officers' table: the Rosalind Keshin Kittay Library has seven trustees: Judy Zinn, Jean Nardi, and Morgan Horton (terms to 2028), Sarah Porter and Anniken Davenport (to 2027), and Wendy McRoy and Lynn Vail (elected 2026)
